Stated Claim / Post Context:
Your ultimate Metro food guide!

Actual Article Body:
View this email in your browser

Sydney’s Southwest Metro is finally open, making it easier to discover great eats across the line.

Tuck into grilled meat skewers in Lakemba, grab a freshly made bánh mì in Bankstown, enjoy yum cha in Campsie or sit down for traditional pizza in Hurlstone Park. Along the way, you'll find bustling cafes, bakeries, dessert spots and family-run restaurants serving dishes from across the globe.

Click the link below for our station-by-station guide and start planning!

All aboard for the grand opening of the new Canterbury Leisure & Aquatic Centre!

Jump on the new Metro to Canterbury and head to Tasker Park this Saturday from 9am for a day packed with free family fun. Enjoy rides, kids' activities and entertainment before the Grand Opening Ceremony at 9:30am and the official opening at 10:15am.

Be among the first to explore the outdoor water play area, sauna and fitness studios, with FREE entry and activities available throughout the day.

Next weekend, Eat Drink Nights Bankstown takes over Paul Keating Park with more than 20 food and drink stalls, live music and plenty to discover.

Enjoy everything from burgers, wagyu and Malaysian satay to Japanese favourites, Indonesian street food, pizza, pasta and Colombian arepas. Treat yourself to gourmet cookies, cupcakes, pancakes, crepes, ice cream, banana pudding, rocky road and loaded churros, or cool down with bubble tea, mocktails, matcha and specialty drinks.

With outdoor seating beneath the iconic red and white umbrellas, it’s the perfect excuse to catch up with friends, enjoy great food and make an evening of it.

What’s coming up around Canterbury-Bankstown!

We’re so excited you joined us!

Catch you soon,

The Where Interesting Happens Team

P.S. Don’t forget to follow us on Facebook and Instagram for real-time updates and behind-the-scenes fun in Canterbury-Bankstown. And hey, share the love with your friends!
